label: Game A
nuance_found: Tower mix per path bend (ballista for single targets, pickle cannon for splash on clumps, mustard to slow, pepper mill near the base), one topping per tower (tomato/cheese/bacon), and timing the burner/rinse/swat abilities on boss and knight clumps. Gold piled up unused after about level 2 so the economy barely forced trade-offs; level 3 knights leaked bites and was the first time placement mattered.
audio: Looping kitchen music that swaps between two tracks, thwip, pop and cannon samples on every shot and kill, a wave ding, and a victory jingle on level clear.
furthest_progress: Cleared level 1 The Cutting Board (3 stars, 10,740), level 2 The Stovetop incl. THE JAR boss (3 stars, 31,200, combo x36), level 3 The Sink (2 stars, 24,400, 15 bites left); reached wave 5/12 of level 4 Sunday Lunch (score 1,900).
control_trouble: Tapping towers/slots needed pixel-accurate coordinates and the camera pans on level start, so I mis-tapped a few times; I also forgot to press START once on level 3 and lost about 40 s.
best_moment: THE JAR boss lumbering down the stovetop path into a wall of cannon splash and a lit burner, with a x36 combo.
worst_moment: Level 1 and 2 are nearly impossible to lose and hundreds of gold sat unspent, so there was no risk-for-reward until the sink.
